sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment 
inspection I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the 
title block.

The present electric hydraulic 
governor system represents the latest development in a continuing program, 
designed to provide the best equipment available for hydraulic turbine speed 
control --- the hydraulic turbine governor is no longer just a speed response 
control of the turbine control of the turbine .

The first draft initiated & tested by 
eng. Khaled Saeed Mohamed , reviewed by eng. Hamdy El Abd Ahmed Zahran, accepted by general director eng.Nagy Nageeb 
Saleh and approved by eng Mohamed Abdel Baset head sector of Aswan dam (1&2) 
hydraulic PS and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakim HPGC MPIS 
Coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued, the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Maintenance staff should be well trained qualified or directly supervised by 
 the some one who is
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذير تحيط بمنطقة العمل.

Wear the personal safety and healthy protective 
 equipment as safety shoes, helmet ,. Etc.
Unit out of service.
Switch off the DC power supply before inserting or withdrawing the relay .

sections.text: الأدوات والمعدات

Signal generator variable from 0 5000 Hz , and minimum 6 to 
 8 volt ( r.m.s ) .

Electric frequency counter to accurately set the signal 
 generator output to the desired frequency .
Multi - range DC voltmeter .

A good oscilloscope and digital voltmeter are very handly to 
 have , although not always necessary .
Current injector ( 0 - 20 MA dc )

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
تحضير
Turn off governor power supply
Pull all modules out of racks
Turn on the governor power supply transfer switch to the test position
Check the main supply ( AC DC )

sections.text:
معايرة التناوب 
المحول التفاضلي المتغير (RVDT)
Put all oil valves and filters in operation
Remove the terminals (AA40 and AA41) from 723 digital control.

At Fully closed position of blade angle measure the current on (RVDT) 
 terminals. It must be (4 MA.)

Inject current of (20 MA ) on proportional valve side , the blade angle 
 must be open at (33), the servomotor must be fully open and we must read the 
 current (20 MA) on (RVDT ) terminals

Measure the voltage between terminals (3,10 )of the blade feed back amplifier
